---
title: "2026 North Carolina State Senate Election Results"
author: "Trinity Harden"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

This map displays the results of the November 2026 North Carolina State Senate elections across all 50 legislative districts. Districts shaded in blue were won by Democrats and districts in red were won by Republicans, with darker shading indicating larger margins of victory.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# 1. Download and read November 2026 results
url <- "https://s3.amazonaws.com/dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/2026_11_03/results_pct_20261103.zip"
temp <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
download.file(url, temp, quiet = TRUE)
raw <- read_tsv(unz(temp, "results_pct_20261103.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Filter for NC State Senate contests and compute margin by district
senate_dist <- raw |>
  filter(str_detect(`Contest Name`, "^NC STATE SENATE")) |>
  mutate(district_num = str_extract(`Contest Name`, "\\d+")) |>
  group_by(district_num, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    total = DEM + REP,
    dem_margin = (DEM - REP) / total * 100,
    winner = ifelse(DEM > REP, "Democrat", "Republican"),
    district_id = sprintf("%03d", as.integer(district_num))
  )

# 3. Get NC State Senate district shapefiles and join results
districts_sf <- state_legislative_districts(
  state = "NC",
  house = "upper",
  cb = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
) |>
  left_join(senate_dist, by = c("SLDUST" = "district_id"))

# 4. Plot map of NC State Senate results
ggplot(districts_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = dem_margin), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#ca0020",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#0571b0",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Margin (%)",
    labels = \(x) paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""), round(x), "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 NC State Senate Results by District",
    subtitle = "50 Seats Total: 26 Republican, 24 Democrat",
    caption = "Source: North Carolina State Board of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
